title: Map — where is the buttons / UI components prototype?

messages.content:
where is the buttons / UI components prototype?

(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

The buttons / UI components prototype is the **CRS UI Kit**:

**`design/CRS_UI_Kit.html`** (136 KB) — the component library / prototype.

Supporting design files in the same folder:
- **`design/tokens.css`** — the color/spacing token source of truth (use these, never hard-code)
- **`design/Styles.txt`** — plain-text style reference
- **`design/design.md`** — design system rules and reasoning

Brain pointer: **`brain/design.md`** (maps design questions → the files above).

That's the one to open for buttons and UI components. Want me to verify what component variants (button states, etc.) it actually contains?
